metadata.title: Feature scope and acceptance ledger
metadata.baseline: Original 110 reference IDs retained; historical vendor implementation excerpts are archived privately.
metadata.status_policy: Implementation statuses are the conservative 0.8.0 baseline, not a current feature inventory or release certificate. See README.md and release-readiness.md for current behavior and validation.

classification.A: Direct public runtime or stable VS Code primitives exist. A new original UI/integration still must be built and tested.
classification.B: Additional state, host integration, service adapter, configuration semantics or runtime/edit-boundary work is required. Some rows depend on capability and account validation.
classification.C: Exact Anthropic service/model/internal-policy parity is not established or unavailable to a Codex-only client. An independently specified alternative is a different deliverable.
classification.X: Dormant, unreachable/unresolved or internal-only baseline candidate excluded from verified public parity scope.

metadata.locale_policy: UI follows VS Code, with English fallback and English/Simplified Chinese overrides; independent of model and speech languages.

features.implementation_plan: Build our own WebviewPanel chat using stable VS Code APIs.
features.acceptance: Open, move and close a chat tab without losing its thread identity.

features.feature: Primary and secondary sidebar chat surfaces
features.implementation_plan: Register primary and secondary WebviewViews sharing the same conversation state.
features.acceptance: Move the chat between sidebars and retain the draft.
features.implementation_note: Secondary Side Bar and editor panels may select independent tabs. Core native surfaces accepted on macOS; dual-side and cross-platform scope remains partial.

features.implementation_plan: Provide a dedicated sessions view independent of the active chat surface.
features.acceptance: Session navigation stays available when a chat is open in an editor.

features.feature: Open conversation in a new VS Code window
features.implementation_plan: Open the selected workspace and thread through a validated extension URI.
features.acceptance: A second window opens the intended thread without silently taking over a writer.

features.feature: Primary editor mode and editor-group locking
features.implementation_plan: Implement preferred location and editor-group locking with saved layout state.
features.acceptance: Opening a source file does not replace the chat or trap it in a locked group.

features.implementation_plan: Separate thread identity, panel identity, ownership and pending RPC state.
features.acceptance: Two concurrent chats stream to the correct panels and never share approvals.
features.implementation_note: Up to eight independent Coordinators/runtimes; per-channel context, drafts, requests, reviews and stream state. Parallel identical RPC identity isolation tested; broader reference/platform acceptance remains partial.

features.feature: Restore chat tabs after window reload
features.implementation_plan: Serialize panel thread IDs and restore from authoritative runtime history.
features.acceptance: Reload restores the correct transcript and a partially typed draft.
features.implementation_note: Versioned tab/group snapshots and separate drafts recover without reconnect or replay. Raw VS Code editor-panel serialization is not implemented.

features.feature: Reopen the last closed session tab
features.implementation_plan: Maintain a bounded recently closed chat stack and contextual reopen binding.
features.acceptance: Reopen restores the last chat; ordinary file-editor reopen still works.
features.implementation_note: Last selected chat/draft reopen after connection; native last-closed-tab serialization remains pending.

features.feature: Keyboard focus input, blur and last response
features.implementation_plan: Implement contextual focus, blur and focus-last-response commands.
features.acceptance: Keyboard users move between editor, composer and last response without a mouse.

features.implementation_plan: Write an English onboarding walkthrough and local completion checklist.
features.acceptance: Every onboarding action reaches a real feature and remains dismissible.

features.implementation_plan: Observe active editor context and show an explicit removable context chip.
features.acceptance: The displayed file reference matches the file sent with the next prompt.
features.implementation_note: Current visible editor is captured locally; explicit send includes one selected range or eligible full file. Exact range, focus retention, stale identities, removal/pin precedence and credential/dirty guards covered; full reference acceptance remains partial.

features.implementation_plan: Track selections with URI, document version and precise ranges.
features.acceptance: A late selection update cannot replace newer context.
features.implementation_note: Automatic exact native editor selection with line-range chips, send identity validation and stale/dirty/credential guards. Native and real selected-token tests pass; multiple selections remain unsupported.

features.implementation_plan: Insert structured mentions using editor commands and line ranges.
features.acceptance: A mention opens the right file and preserves the selected lines.
features.implementation_note: Explicit native selections and inline @ file references using opaque per-view IDs and host-validated attachment acknowledgements. Typed arbitrary line-range syntax remains pending.

features.feature: Fuzzy project file and folder search
features.implementation_plan: Use VS Code search or the runtime file-search primitive with ignore controls.
features.acceptance: Fuzzy search finds files and folders while exclusions remain effective.
features.implementation_note: Inline case-insensitive path/filename and subsequence matching, 5,000-path scan and 20-result cap, keyboard navigation and stale-result refusal. Folder references and an indexed uncapped search remain pending.

features.feature: Attach images, PDF and text files
features.implementation_plan: Handle text/images directly; add bounded PDF extraction or a supported file-tool adapter.
features.acceptance: The agent receives actual supported content; an unprocessed PDF is never shown as understood.

features.feature: Clipboard image paste and drag-and-drop attachments
features.implementation_plan: Implement clipboard-image and drop handling with MIME/size validation and host URI mapping.
features.acceptance: Paste/drop works locally and fails clearly for unsupported remote attachments.

features.implementation_plan: Implement documented invisible-character cleaning with a review step for changed pasted text.
features.acceptance: A changed prompt is returned for review rather than silently sent.

features.implementation_plan: Persist bounded composer input history separately from the draft.
features.acceptance: Up/down recalls input without overwriting a current unsent draft.

features.implementation_plan: Build browser-reference support through a separately installed supported browser MCP/extension.
features.acceptance: A selected tab reference resolves to the intended authorized browser context.

features.implementation_plan: Capture shell-integration output when available; offer selected-output fallback and explicit history limits.
features.acceptance: Late attachment never claims to contain terminal history the extension did not observe.

features.feature: Save dirty editor files before agent reads/writes
features.implementation_plan: Coordinate dirty editor buffers with reads and the edit boundary; avoid silent blanket saves.
features.acceptance: Unsaved user edits cannot be overwritten or omitted without an explicit conflict result.

features.feature: Language diagnostics exposed to the agent
features.implementation_plan: Expose a read-only VS Code diagnostics tool through the runtime dynamic-tool/MCP interface.
features.acceptance: The agent gets diagnostics for the selected URI and knows when analysis is unavailable.

features.implementation_plan: Implement the selected Enter/Cmd-or-Ctrl-Enter behavior, respecting composition events.
features.acceptance: Chinese IME composition never submits a message accidentally.

features.implementation_plan: Represent queued, working, awaiting input and compacting states explicitly.
features.acceptance: A queued message is not marked sent or completed before runtime acknowledgement.
features.implementation_note: Native text queue/steer/removal is connected; queue add/list/delete accepted on isolated 0.152.0. Full active live queue interaction and attached follow-ups remain unaccepted.

features.implementation_plan: Add microphone capture, transcription transport and audio-level UX via a supported provider.
features.acceptance: Permission denial, stop and transcription errors preserve the draft; no hidden recording.

features.feature: Voice language follows configured language/VS Code speech language
features.implementation_plan: Keep dictation-language selection separate from UI locale and model response language.
features.acceptance: Changing the UI language does not silently change speech processing.

features.feature: Streaming response and partial tool events
features.implementation_plan: Render incremental runtime items with thread/turn/item IDs and ordered updates.
features.acceptance: Delta fragments assemble once; failed or interrupted turns never display as successful.
features.implementation_note: Streaming response and command output with expandable activity metadata; runtime-provided tool names, durations, exit codes and status retained through deltas. Live-work summary and stopped-event distinction added.

features.implementation_plan: Cancel the active runtime turn and reconcile terminal/task states.
features.acceptance: The UI waits for the actual interrupted/completed result and exposes remaining child work.

features.implementation_plan: Render real runtime approval requests scoped to thread, turn and item.
features.acceptance: An approval in one chat cannot authorize an item in another chat.

features.implementation_plan: Map edit acceptance to the edit boundary and runtime sandbox policy; do not auto-approve every tool.
features.acceptance: Automatic edits do not implicitly grant network, external-root or shell permissions.

features.implementation_plan: Use the runtime plan collaboration mode and expose it beside the composer.
features.acceptance: A visible Plan control changes actual runtime mode; source-writing behavior is tested separately.

features.implementation_plan: Use Codex auto review and display its actual review state, with provider/policy filtering.
features.acceptance: The feature invokes the runtime reviewer rather than blindly approving requests.

features.feature: Bypass permissions mode with explicit enabling
features.implementation_plan: Expose the supported unrestricted profile only through explicit user selection and clear scope.
features.acceptance: The UI and runtime agree about current access; workspace policy remains authoritative.
features.implementation_note: Native allowed permission profiles and full-access confirmation exist. Native execution is separate from reviewed edits; every bypass/managed-policy scenario is not accepted.

features.implementation_plan: Edit Codex-native rules, validate schema and scope, and read back effective policy.
features.acceptance: A denied or invalid rule write is not displayed as saved.

features.implementation_plan: Choose among supported sandbox/permission profiles with their effective constraints.
features.acceptance: Read-only/workspace/full-access labels reflect the actual allowed policy.

features.implementation_plan: Render structured questions and complete/cancel their correlated responses.
features.acceptance: Reload or cancellation resolves pending questions without accidentally choosing the default.

features.feature: Quick side questions without replacing main task
features.implementation_plan: Use a distinct read-only child conversation for side questions with its own lifecycle.
features.acceptance: A side answer does not replace, steer or interrupt the main task.

features.implementation_plan: Build background-task controls around supported process and subagent events.
features.acceptance: Moving work to the background actually returns control and shows continuing output.
features.implementation_note: Native child discovery and background status, including pending/uncertain nested tasks. Real gpt-5.6-sol v2 child creation/parent-result and synthetic native v1 execution pass. Background terminal management and broader service acceptance remain open.

features.implementation_plan: Implement separate stop paths for commands versus subagents; capability-probe each.
features.acceptance: Stop targets only the selected task and reports unsupported subagent cancellation honestly.
features.implementation_note: Owning runtime interrupts the selected verified child current turn. Real v2 native readback and synthetic v1 acceptance pass; parent can keep waiting and is stopped separately. Permanent child closure and background terminals are not provided.

features.feature: Task output and subagent transcript inspection
features.implementation_plan: Render child-thread transcripts and bounded command output with live status.
features.acceptance: Opening a task cannot start a second copy or confuse its transcript with the parent.
features.implementation_note: Verified child transcript pagination and live updates without resume. Real v2 child/parent tokens and synthetic native v1 ancestry/output pass. Scope remains partial for broader service/model/host combinations.

features.implementation_plan: Provide rendered and editable plan documents with explicit saved-version identity.
features.acceptance: The executed plan corresponds to the version the user reviewed.

features.feature: Review and comment on plan preview
features.implementation_plan: Store comments against plan revision and stable text ranges, then send review feedback.
features.acceptance: Editing a plan cannot silently attach an old comment to unrelated text.

features.implementation_plan: Use VS Code virtual documents plus the native diff editor for before/proposed content.
features.acceptance: The native diff opens the correct versions and handles read-only previews.
features.implementation_note: Existing EditorReview virtual before/proposed documents open the native diff. Native editor acceptance covers the restricted existing-text path; full reference/platform acceptance remains incomplete. Corrected during the product-baseline assessment, without a new implementation change.

features.feature: Accept or reject whole proposed edit
features.implementation_plan: Separate pre-apply proposal decisions from post-apply revert; introduce an edit boundary if required.
features.acceptance: Rejecting a pending edit leaves the target bytes and dirty buffer unchanged.
features.implementation_note: Client-held proposals support accept/reject of existing-file text; runtime remains read-only. No new/delete/rename or multi-file transaction.

features.implementation_plan: Provide genuine pre-apply hunk decisions; public whole-item approvals cannot encode arbitrary accepted hunks.
features.acceptance: Accept hunk A and reject B before writing; overlapping edits result in a conflict.
features.implementation_note: Selected exact-text replacements are applied before any source mutation; arbitrary native diff-hunk semantics remain partial.

features.implementation_plan: Build a changes overview over versioned before/after documents.
features.acceptance: Every changed file opens the corresponding diff without staging unrelated work.

features.feature: Track diagnostics added by agent edits
features.implementation_plan: Record diagnostics before edits and compare after the language service updates.
features.acceptance: Report only attributable diagnostic changes and do not equate no diagnostics with passing tests.

features.implementation_plan: Implement durable before/after checkpoints with an edit barrier, provenance and conflict-safe restore.
features.acceptance: Rewind survives reload and preserves later manual changes or reports a visible conflict.
features.implementation_note: Durable prepared/applied/restored records and conflict-checked text restore for existing files only; full rewind remains partial.

features.feature: Fork conversation at a selected message
features.implementation_plan: Fork using beforeTurnId and preserve the original conversation and working-tree semantics.
features.acceptance: The selected boundary excludes the intended turn and later history; code remains unchanged.

features.feature: Fork conversation and rewind code together
features.implementation_plan: Coordinate a conversation fork with a checked code restore as two recoverable operations.
features.acceptance: A partial failure cannot report both operations successful or destroy the original chat.

features.implementation_plan: Use paginated runtime history rather than parsing private transcript files.
features.acceptance: Resume selects the correct workspace/thread and loads older history without duplication.

features.implementation_plan: Use title filtering by default; enable full-text search only when the runtime supports it.
features.acceptance: The UI labels title-only search correctly and paginates the complete result set.
features.implementation_note: Real runtime title/message search with canonical workspace/provider filtering and explicit paging.

features.implementation_plan: Expose rename and adopt runtime titles; any extra model-generated title is an explicit generation choice.
features.acceptance: Rename persists after restart and stale updates cannot replace it.
features.implementation_note: Runtime rename of the active owned chat; full automatic-title workflow remains partial.

features.implementation_plan: Archive and restore through runtime methods and refresh the authoritative list.
features.acceptance: Restoring an archived thread does not duplicate or delete it.
features.implementation_note: Owned chat archive/restore exercised through the real runtime; unknown outcomes require reconciliation.

features.implementation_plan: Add an idle-session policy with open/running/waiting/unread exceptions.
features.acceptance: No running, open or unread conversation is auto-archived.

features.implementation_plan: Use runtime sections when verified, otherwise extension-owned presentation metadata.
features.acceptance: Names, order and collapsed state survive restart without moving source code.
features.implementation_note: Local named groups support creation, rename, ordering, collapse and assignment to open conversations; loaded history memberships retained. No shared-runtime group synchronization.

features.implementation_plan: Merge runtime activity with local read/unread metadata and update all views.
features.acceptance: A background completion becomes unread exactly once and open views reconcile it.
features.implementation_note: Closed-tab drafts/history survive; hidden views do not consume background unread. Cross-platform and official-client organization remain unverified.

features.feature: Protect a session already open elsewhere
features.implementation_plan: Coordinate participating clients with a writer lease; establish runtime-enforced ownership or verified external-client detection separately.
features.acceptance: Test two extension windows and official CLI/IDE/desktop coexistence. If external exclusion cannot be guaranteed, declare simultaneous external access unsupported; do not claim full held-elsewhere parity.
features.implementation_note: Passive reads and explicit Continue/Fork use native writer enforcement. Isolated writer refusal/release-after-process-stop accepted; unsubscribe alone is insufficient. Official cross-version IDE/desktop coexistence is unverified.

features.feature: Continue an interrupted step after reload
features.implementation_plan: Reconcile delivery and task state after restart; continue only when replay is safe.
features.acceptance: Crash after request delivery does not automatically repeat a destructive command.

features.implementation_plan: Restore tabs through persisted UI state and bounded failure counters.
features.acceptance: A repeatedly failing restore remains recoverable from the history list.
features.implementation_note: Versioned local tab/group layout and distinct drafts recover after host recreation without reconnecting or replaying unfinished requests. Raw editor-panel serialization remains absent.

features.implementation_plan: Store bookmarks against stable response/item identities in extension-owned metadata.
features.acceptance: Bookmarked content remains addressable after paging, reload and chat rename.

features.implementation_plan: Export only after loading the requested history; write through a save dialog.
features.acceptance: Export includes the chosen scope and cannot overwrite an existing file silently.
features.implementation_note: Explicit full native-history export of user messages, assistant responses and plans to clipboard or an unsaved Markdown document. Turn/item pagination, active/changed history and size guards are tested; tool activity and attachment bytes are explicitly excluded. macOS/Linux installed-package synthetic native MCP workflow exercises both destinations. Broader reference/platform acceptance remains partial.

features.implementation_plan: Populate models from the runtime catalog and handle access errors separately.
features.acceptance: A listed model is not presented as proven entitled until an actual turn succeeds.
features.implementation_note: Native model defaults and local per-chat preferences are retained; unsupported inherited choices block Send without downgrade.

features.implementation_plan: Use the selected model's supported reasoning effort values.
features.acceptance: Unsupported effort values are never sent or shown as active.
features.implementation_note: Exact Max reaches native turn/start and a completed real test history returned stored effort max with matching final token/applied patch. Full UI rerun hit HTTP 429; no replay or final disk readback claim.

features.implementation_plan: Map reasoning controls and display to Codex-supported summaries; disclose provider differences.
features.acceptance: Do not promise Claude's exact hidden reasoning, budgets or presentation.

features.implementation_plan: Anthropic Ultracode orchestration has no established public Codex-equivalent contract; a separate workflow feature is possible.
features.acceptance: Do not label high effort or a generic subagent prompt as Ultracode parity.

features.implementation_plan: Expose a runtime-advertised service tier only when the account and model support it.
features.acceptance: Fast mode changes a real supported service tier and displays applicable usage information.

features.feature: Switch model when message is flagged
features.implementation_plan: Exact Anthropic flagged-message fallback policy cannot be inherited by a Codex client.
features.acceptance: Do not bypass moderation or claim Anthropic policy equivalence.

features.implementation_plan: Implement user-editable output style instructions using Codex's supported instruction scope.
features.acceptance: Styles affect only the intended scope and never replace project security instructions.

features.implementation_plan: Render available account limits and actual usage with missing-data states.
features.acceptance: Unknown or missing usage is not converted to zero; do not invent dollar costs.
features.implementation_note: On-demand native account/rateLimits/read, multiple buckets, reset times and unavailable states; account identifiers, credit metadata and backend banners are not projected. Existing real CLI authorization accepts a metadata-only account-limit read. No dollar-cost estimates or reset purchases. macOS/Linux installed-editor native transport acceptance; broader accounts/platforms remain partial.

features.implementation_plan: Show available token usage and context limits, with clear boundaries on unavailable attribution.
features.acceptance: Do not invent per-tool/skill cache-cost attribution absent from the runtime.
features.implementation_note: Native thread/tokenUsage/updated displays last request tokens, context limit and cumulative input/cache/output/reasoning values. Unknown stays unknown; no per-tool cost attribution or exact context-occupancy claim. Native isolated Responses/MCP/editor acceptance passes; historical totals require a runtime update.

features.implementation_plan: Show version, model, workspace, permissions and runtime status without secrets.
features.acceptance: A diagnostic status view can be shared after redaction without leaking tokens.

features.implementation_plan: Build a command registry for supported built-ins and skills; adapt semantics, not just names.
features.acceptance: Every advertised slash command has working behavior or an explicit unavailable explanation.
features.implementation_note: Runtime Skills discovery, filtering, typed explicit skill inputs through $ selection and implemented / navigation/mode commands. No arbitrary command loader or fine-grained Claude skill translation.

features.implementation_plan: Map enabled/disabled skill state; assess Claude's finer invocation states separately.
features.acceptance: Unsupported name-only/invocable distinctions are never silently collapsed.
features.implementation_note: Native Codex enabled/disabled state is discovered and changed with effective readback. Claude name-only/invocable/off and per-skill model/permission/hooks metadata are not translated.

features.implementation_plan: Provide scope-aware hook editing and effective readback through supported Codex configuration.
features.acceptance: Unknown fields survive edits and rejected writes remain visibly unsaved.
features.implementation_note: Native Hook inventory, command/MCP definition trust, enablement and source opening. Isolated command hook execution/trust/toggle and reviewed isolation observed; full editing/event matrix not accepted.

features.implementation_plan: Build plugin management only for supported runtime versions/providers; current docs warn parts are under development.
features.acceptance: Discovery, auth, install and failure states are real; schema presence alone cannot enable the feature.
features.implementation_note: Native local catalog/installed/install/toggle/remove accepted in isolated runtime; plugin updates, app auth and every remote source are incomplete.

features.implementation_plan: Support Codex-compatible marketplace sources and validated install links.
features.acceptance: An unsupported Claude marketplace is not claimed compatible because it is a Git URL.
features.implementation_note: Runtime-provided marketplace catalog can select installation. Arbitrary source import, install links and policy variants remain incomplete.

features.implementation_plan: Use declared plugin option schemas and provider APIs when available.
features.acceptance: Secrets are stored through approved mechanisms and never echoed into a webview or report.

features.implementation_plan: Build a sandboxed rich-plugin UI surface using supported MCP Apps; native Claude engine_ui compatibility is not established.
features.acceptance: An app cannot access local files or host commands outside the validated bridge.

features.implementation_plan: Implement scope-aware MCP configuration, trust, OAuth and reconnection with readback.
features.acceptance: Credentials remain outside the webview and reconnect errors are actionable.
features.implementation_note: Native MCP CRUD/grants and OAuth completion/auth readback, URL authorization and standard flat form elicitation. Bounded schemas, private-snapshot validation, typed answers, decline/cancel and turn identity checks. Native isolated CLI and macOS/Linux installed-editor synthetic provider acceptance; external providers and openai/form/uncorrelated requests remain unsupported.

features.implementation_plan: Open/edit AGENTS.md and supported Codex instruction locations with normal editor semantics.
features.acceptance: Editing instructions does not rewrite or relabel unrelated CLAUDE.md files.

features.implementation_plan: Expose only documented Codex memory roots and controls; provider memory remains distinct.
features.acceptance: The UI states which memory scope is being viewed and whether a setting took effect.
features.implementation_note: Native feature/per-chat setter plus bounded read-only local memory browser. Actual VS Code preview and link/encoding/path tests pass. Native setter lacks getter; reconnect shows unknown. ChatGPT web memory is separate.

features.implementation_plan: Use validated known-root file operations with preview/recovery for memory changes.
features.acceptance: A malicious relative path cannot read, replace or delete outside the selected memory root.
features.implementation_note: Read-only memory metadata and bounded on-demand UTF-8 preview, opaque IDs, canonical roots, file identity and link/hard-link protection. Writes/deletes remain unimplemented.

features.feature: Git worktree creation and open folder
features.implementation_plan: Implement Git worktree lifecycle and dedicated windows with recoverable cleanup; Claude command reachability is unresolved.
features.acceptance: Creating a worktree preserves the original dirty checkout; removing one never discards user work.

features.feature: Cloud conversation list and local resume
features.implementation_plan: Exact Anthropic cloud session listing/resume is a vendor service, not part of Codex app-server's local thread API.
features.acceptance: A local Codex history view is not presented as synced Claude cloud history.

features.implementation_plan: Exact Anthropic cloud import ownership/repository semantics require its supported service access.
features.acceptance: Do not parse private auth files or call undocumented cloud endpoints to imitate this.

features.implementation_plan: Investigate Codex-native remote control through supported authenticated routes; treat account/service access as a dependency.
features.acceptance: Remote control is enabled only after verified authorization and never exposes a bare public listener.

features.feature: Enable Remote Control for future sessions
features.implementation_plan: Persist an opt-in default only after supported policy and consent flows are established.
features.acceptance: A future-session default cannot silently broaden remote access.

features.implementation_plan: Provide equivalent browser tasks through a supported browser MCP/companion; Claude in Chrome binary compatibility is not established.
features.acceptance: The user can identify the browser/tab and observe or cancel authorized actions.

features.implementation_plan: Claude Design is an Anthropic service; a Codex extension has no established equivalent account/API route.
features.acceptance: Do not display a decorative sign-in or claim the proprietary service is available.

features.implementation_plan: Open the installed Codex CLI with validated thread-resume arguments and the correct workspace.
features.acceptance: Terminal resume uses the intended thread without creating a duplicate writer.

features.feature: IDE MCP bridge for terminal CLI
features.implementation_plan: Build a small local IDE MCP bridge with narrow diagnostics/selection/open-file tools if terminal parity requires it.
features.acceptance: Only the selected local runtime can use the bridge; no unauthenticated network exposure.

features.implementation_plan: Use the installed Python extension environment API for the active workspace when available.
features.acceptance: Missing Python support degrades clearly and cannot replace another workspace's environment.

features.implementation_plan: Dormant/unresolved Claude notebook factory is not an established public parity requirement.
features.acceptance: Keep it in the audit ledger; do not count notebook execution as delivered or required from names alone.

features.implementation_plan: Claude's debugger factory is inactive in this build; leave it outside verified public parity.
features.acceptance: Do not claim debugger feature support from packaged schemas or strings.

features.implementation_plan: Use maintained Markdown/code/math rendering packages with safe content handling.
features.acceptance: Code copies correctly, math preserves source, links are validated and scripts cannot execute.

features.feature: Copy assistant response and copy slash action
features.implementation_plan: Copy source response text and expose the same action through a working command.
features.acceptance: Copied code and math retain exact source formatting.

features.implementation_plan: Add a presentation-only Focus view with a live tool indicator and reversible expansion.
features.acceptance: Hiding activity never loses approval prompts or conceals failures.
features.implementation_note: Focus view hides completed activity but preserves failures, active/stopped events, decisions and edit reviews; saved per webview. Renderer interaction acceptance is separate from native model interaction.

features.implementation_plan: Render message timestamps and day separators using the chosen UI locale.
features.acceptance: Timestamps remain accurate across midnight and time-zone changes.

features.implementation_plan: Use VS Code typography variables and respond to configuration changes.
features.acceptance: Font changes apply without truncating input, code or tool labels.

features.implementation_plan: Use VS Code theme variables and light/dark/high-contrast states.
features.acceptance: All supported themes retain readable text, focus and approval states.

features.implementation_plan: Implement keyboard focus, accessible names and polite progress announcements, then test with VoiceOver/NVDA.
features.acceptance: Keyboard-only users can send, stop, review a diff and answer an approval.

features.implementation_plan: Use English source strings and document language by default.
features.acceptance: A fresh install follows VS Code display language, with English fallback. Explicit English/Simplified Chinese overrides preserve task, draft, focus and approvals and do not alter response or speech language.

features.implementation_plan: Use a supported spellcheck API/provider when available, with local dictionary controls.
features.acceptance: Absent capability is shown clearly; code identifiers are not silently rewritten.

features.implementation_plan: Provide a local output channel and structured redacted errors with correlation IDs.
features.acceptance: A failed RPC produces an actionable error and no token-bearing diagnostic.

features.implementation_plan: Generate redacted local bug bundles and an explicit user-initiated project issue flow.
features.acceptance: No source code, prompt, credentials or telemetry is uploaded automatically.

features.implementation_plan: Use ordinary Marketplace/VSIX/Open VSX update routes, with editor detection.
features.acceptance: Install/update links identify the correct editor and published package.

features.implementation_plan: Declare untrustedWorkspaces unsupported until restricted-mode behavior is intentionally built.
features.acceptance: An untrusted folder cannot start an agent process or execute its project configuration.

features.implementation_plan: Internal Anthropic issue/share/reset actions are not part of the public baseline.
features.acceptance: Do not copy internal entitlements, branding or private endpoints.

features.feature: English default and selectable UI language
features.implementation_plan: English source catalog plus Simplified Chinese catalog and explicit per-extension language selection. Keep generated responses and speech language independent. Contributed manifest labels follow VS Code localization semantics.
features.acceptance: A fresh install follows VS Code display language, with English fallback. Explicit English/Simplified Chinese overrides preserve task, draft, focus and approvals and do not alter response or speech language.
features.implementation_note: Owner revised the default to follow VS Code display language. Native Auto/en/zh-CN settings replace the in-chat selector; no model/speech language coupling. Native labels still follow VS Code locale/reload behavior.
